scoring_justification: Recompute accuracy, F1, R², MAE from agent's prediction CSVs using provided true columns, and compare to paper-reported performance thresholds (threshold_or_better).

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported performance thresholds for polynomial featurization models per metal and property.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper figures 4 and supplementary tables III, IV, V and main text.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Thresholds are the paper's reported values minus (for higher-better) or plus (for lower-better) the tolerances declared in the task plan, giving a monotonic floor/ceiling that a correct reproduction must meet.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Thresholds are derived from the paper's own published measurements for the same featurization and evaluation procedure.

outputs.description: File must contain the test‑set true and predicted coordination numbers for every metal. The checker recomputes accuracy and F1 scores from these predictions and compares to paper‑reported gold values.
File must contain the test‑set true and predicted mean nearest‑neighbor distances for every metal. The checker recomputes R² and MAE (in Å) and compares to paper‑reported values.
File must contain the test‑set true and predicted Bader charges for every metal. The checker recomputes R² and MAE (in elementary charge) and compares to paper‑reported values.

coordination.description: per‑metal classification metrics; each metal object must contain accuracy, f1_4, f1_5, f1_6 (all floats)

distance.description: per‑metal regression metrics; each metal object must contain R2, MAE (floats)

charge.description: per‑metal regression metrics; each metal object must contain R2, MAE (floats)

outputs.description: Agent‑reported metrics computed from the test‑set predictions. The checker verifies consistency with the metrics recomputed from the prediction CSV files (difference < 0.01).

output_contract.notes: The task reproduces only the multiscale polynomial featurization branch of the paper. The raw prediction CSV files are scored by recomputing the headline metrics against hidden true labels; the metrics.json serves as a consistency check.

steps.description: Recompute accuracy and per-class F1 per metal from predictions and compare to paper thresholds.
Verify that metrics.json values match recomputed metrics from all prediction CSVs within tolerance (0.01).
